_about: Palettes for the downloaded models (2026-10-19). A model keeps the colours of its pack on disk; a room's pack turns them into one of these when it loads (client/src/components/Map/interiors/tones.ts), and tools/convert-assets.mjs can bake one in (tone=<name>). ramp: dark, middle and light stops in sRGB, by the lightness of the colour they replace; accent: what the saturated colours of the model (a stripe, a lamp, a hazard mark) become.
